result.summary: This PR fixes bitcoin-cli's -getinfo command, which was displaying '(none)' for the Warnings field even when getnetworkinfo returned an array of active warnings, because the old code called getValStr() which does not handle arrays. It updates ParseGetInfoResult to join array elements with newlines while preserving the legacy string/empty fallback, and adds functional test coverage that parses the full Warnings section from the CLI output.
result.problem: Users running -getinfo on nodes with array-form warnings (introduced when getnetworkinfo's warnings field became a list) saw a misleading '(none)' instead of the real warning text, hiding potentially important prerelease or network warnings from operators.

result.card: This PR fixes a bug in bitcoin-cli's -getinfo command where warnings returned as an array by getnetworkinfo were displayed as '(none)' instead of the actual warning text, per the author's description: '-getinfo swallowed warnings when getnetworkinfo returns an array instead of string.' It is a small, targeted CLI display fix with functional test coverage added. Reviewer stickies-v gave a Concept ACK and has since (2026-09-16) suggested a layout rework to match the existing Balances section style and asked for commit squashing, feedback the author has not yet addressed. No blocking objections exist, and the fix is cosmetic in nature but genuinely restores hidden warning visibility for operators. Belongs to the rpc category (bitcoin-cli is the RPC client) and not to tools, which explicitly excludes it.
